verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              प्रादुर्भूते ततस्तस्मिन्नस्त्रे नारायणे प्रभो।  प्रावात्सपृषतो वायुरनभ्रे स्तनयित्नुमान्॥१॥
चचाल पृथिवी चापि चुक्षुभे च महोदधिः।  प्रतिस्रोतः प्रवृत्ताश्च गन्तुं तत्र समुद्रगाः॥२॥
verses.english: The earth quaked and the oceans became agitated. The ocean-going stream began to flow in contrary directions.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रादुरिति । सपृषतः सजलबिन्दुः अनभ्रे अप्रावृषि काले ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: शिखराणि व्यशीर्यन्त गिरीणां तत्र भारत।  अपसव्यं मृगाश्चैव पाण्डुसेनां प्रचक्रिरे॥३॥
verses.english: The crests of mountains, O Bharata, began 10 split up. Diverse animals then passed keeping the son of Pandu to their right.

verses.sanskrit: तमसा चावकीर्यन्त सूर्यश्च कलुषोऽभवत्।  संपतन्ति च भूतानि क्रव्यादानि प्रहृष्टवत्॥४॥
देवदानवगन्धर्वास्त्रस्तास्त्वासन्विशांपते।  कथंकथाऽभवत्तीव्रा दृष्ट्वा तद्व्याकुलं महत्॥५॥
verses.english: O Ruler of men, celestials, the Danavas and the Gandharvas all became filled with fear. Seeing then that tremendous agitation in nature, they began to question one another saying, what is the cause of all this?

verses.sanskrit: व्यथिताः सर्वराजानस्त्रस्ताश्चासन्विशांपते। तद्दृष्ट्वा घोररूपं वै द्रौणेरस्त्रं भयावहम्॥६॥
verses.english: All the kings became filled with anxiety and inspired with terror, O ruler of men, at the sight of that dreadful weapon of affrighting aspect, belonging to Drona's son.
verses.bhavadeepa: कथंकथा कथं कर्तव्यं कथं कर्तव्यमित्येवं शब्दः ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              निवर्तितेषु सैन्येषु द्रोणपुत्रेण संयुगे। भृशं शोकाभितप्तेन पितुर्वधममृष्यता॥७॥
कुरूनापततो दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य रक्षणे। को मन्त्रः पाण्डवेष्वासीत्तन्ममाचक्ष्व सञ्जय॥८॥
verses.english: Tell me, O Sanjaya, what consultation then the Pandavas held for protecting Dhristadyumna, as they saw the Kurus return to the charge.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              प्रागेव विद्रुतान्दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान् युधिष्ठिरः।  पुनश्च तुमुलं शब्दं श्रुत्वाऽर्जुनमथाब्रवीत्॥९॥

युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              आचार्ये निहते द्रोणे धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे।  निहते वज्रहस्तेन यथा वृत्रे महासुरे॥१०॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said Upon the slaughter of the preceptor Drona by Dhristadyumna like the slaughter of the mighly Asura Vrita by the wielder of thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: नाशंसन्तो जयं युद्धे दीनात्मानो धनञ्जय।  आत्मत्राणे मतिं कृत्वा प्राद्रवन्कुरवो रणात्॥११॥
केचिद्भ्रान्तै रथैस्तूर्णं निहतैः पार्ष्णियन्तृभिः।  विपताकध्वजच्छत्रैः पार्थिवाः शीर्णकूबरैः॥१२॥
verses.english: Some rulers of men fled on chariots borne along irregular courses, with parshni drivers slain, deprived of standards, streamers and umbrellas, with their boxes and Kuvaras shattered and all their decorations displaced. Others again, panic-struck and deprived of reason, goading the steeds of their chariots with their toes, fled in all haste.

verses.sanskrit: भग्ननीडैराकुलाश्वैः प्रारुह्यान्यान्विचेतसः।  भीताः पादैर्हयान्केचित्त्वरयन्तः स्वयं रथान्॥१३॥
भग्नाक्षयुगचक्रैश्च व्याकृष्यन्त समन्ततः।  रथान्विशीर्णानुत्सृज्य पद्भिः केचिच्चविद्रुताः॥१४॥
हयपृष्ठगताश्चान्ये कृष्यन्तेऽर्धच्युतासनाः।  गजस्कन्धेषु संस्यूता नाराचैश्चलितासनाः॥१५॥
verses.english: Others again displaced from their seats and riveted with shafts on the necks of elephants, were precipitately borne away by those animals. Others were crushed down by flying elephants, mangled and pierced with arrows.

verses.sanskrit: शरातैर्विद्रुतैर्नागैर्हृताः केचिद्दिशो दश।  विशस्त्रकवचाश्चान्ये वाहनेभ्यः क्षितिं गताः॥१६॥
verses.english: Others with their armours taken off and weapons exhausted fell down on the earth from the back of their animals. Others again were mutilated by car-wheels or crushed by steeds of elephants.

verses.sanskrit: संच्छिन्ना नेमिभिश्चैव मृदिताश्च हयद्विपैः।  क्रोशन्तस्तात पुत्रोत पलायन्ते परे भयात्॥१७॥
verses.english: Some loudly calling their sires and their sons fled away in fear, without recognising one another and reduced in energy by grief.

verses.sanskrit: नाभिजानन्ति चान्योन्यं कश्मलाभिहतौजसः।  पुत्रान्पितॄन्सखीन्भ्रातॄन्समारोप्य दृढक्षतान्॥१८॥
जलेन क्लेदयन्त्यन्ये विमुच्य कवचान्यपि।  अवस्थां तादृशीं प्राप्य हते द्रोणे द्रुतं बलम्॥१९॥
verses.english: After the slaughter of Drona, the enemy's host, falling into great distress, fled away in haste. Who hath rallied it now? Tell me if you know it.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरावर्तितं केन यदि जानासि शंस मे।  हयानां ह्रेषतां शब्दः कुञ्जराणां च बृंहताम्॥२०॥
verses.english: The sound of neighing steeds and roaring clephants mangled with the clatter of carwheels in heard aloud.

verses.sanskrit: रथनेमिस्वनैश्चात्र विमिश्रः श्रूयते महान्।  एते शब्दा भृशं तीव्राः प्रवृत्ताः कुरुसागरे॥२१॥
verses.english: These terrible sounds in the ocean of Kuru army, are swelling every moment and causing my troops to tremble.

verses.sanskrit: मुहुर्मुहुरुदीर्यन्ते कम्पयन्त्यपि मामकान्।  य एष तुमुलः शब्दः श्रूयते लोमहर्षणः॥२२॥
verses.english: This tremendous sound that is assailing our ears, causing our hair to stand erect, Meseems, will devour up the three worlds with their lords.

verses.sanskrit: सेन्द्रानप्येष लोकांस्त्रीन् ग्रसेदिति मतिर्मम।  मन्ये वज्रधरस्यैष निनादो भैरवस्वनः॥२३॥
verses.english: I think this to be the tremendous roar of the wielder of the thunder, viz., Vasava, who cnraged at the slaughter of Drona is coming to fight on behalf of the Kauravas.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणे हते कौरवार्थं व्यक्तमभ्येति वासवः।  प्रहृष्टरोमकूपाश्च संविग्ना रथपुङ्गवाः॥२४॥
verses.english: ( Dhananjaya, hearing this loud and terrible sound our hairs stand erect and our best car-warriors are becoming filled with anxiety.

verses.sanskrit: धनञ्जय गुरुं श्रुत्वा तत्र नादं सुभीषणम्।  क एष कौरवान्दीर्णानवस्थाप्य महारथः॥२५॥

निवर्तयति युद्धार्थं मृधे देवेश्वरो यथा।
              अर्जुन उवाच।
              उद्यम्यात्मानमुग्राय कर्मणे वीर्यमास्थिताः॥२६॥
verses.english: I ask you who is this mighty car-warrior that rallying this terrible and agitated host like the lord of the celestials themselves, is leading it to the charge.

verses.sanskrit: धमन्ति कौरवाःशंखान्यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रिताः।  यत्र ते संशयो राजन्न्यस्तशस्त्रे गुरौ हते॥२७॥
verses.english: Arjuna said He depending upon whose prowess the Kauravas, having addressed themselves to the accomplishment of ficrce deeds, are blowing their conches and facing us with firmness.

verses.sanskrit: धार्तराष्ट्रानवस्थाप्य क एष नदतीति हि।  ह्रीमन्तं तं महाबाहुं मत्तद्विरदगामिनम्॥२८॥
verses.english: He about whom you entertain doubts as to who he may be who, having rallied the troops of the son of Dhritarashtra, that had fled from the fall of the weaponless Drona, is now uttering terrible roars.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रास्यमुग्रकर्माणं कुरूणामभयङ्करम्।  यस्मिञ्जाते ददौ द्रोणो गवां दशशतं धनम्॥२९॥
verses.english: He, upon whose birth Drona distributed a thousand kine among Brahmanas of highworth, he, Oking, is Ashvatthaman who is thus roaring.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो महार्हेभ्यः सोऽश्वत्थामैष गर्जति।  जातमात्रेण वीरेण येनोच्चैःश्रवसा यथा॥३०॥
verses.english: As soon as he was born that hero ncighed like Uchhaisravas and thereby caused the three words to tremble.
verses.bhavadeepa: यस्मिन्निति । दशशतमित्यनेन सर्वगोधनं ददाविति ज्ञेयम् । अन्यथा एकधेन्वर्थं द्रुपदं प्रति द्रोणगमनस्यासंभवः । यद्वा भाविनीं संपदमभिलक्ष्यैतद्दानं द्रष्टव्यं पुत्रोत्पत्तिकाले तस्य निर्धनत्वोक्तेः ॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: ह्रेषता कम्पिता भूमिर्लोकाश्च सकलास्त्रयः।  तच्छ्रुत्वाऽन्तर्हितं भूतं नाम तस्याकरोत्तदा॥३१॥
अश्वत्थामेति सोऽद्यैष शूरो नदति पाण्डव।  यो ह्यनाथ इवाक्रम्य पार्षतेन हतस्तथा॥३२॥
verses.english: Having heard that sound, an invisible being, master, ascribed to him the Ashvatthman, (horse-voiced). That brave warrior, O son of Pandu, is roaring today.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा सुनृशंसेन तस्य नाथो व्यवस्थितः।  गुरुं मे यत्र पाञ्चाल्यः केशपक्षे परामृशत्॥३३॥
verses.english: He, who has been slain like one helpless by the son of Prisata, by a cruel and deceitful means, yonder stands the protector of that one. name

verses.sanskrit: तन्न जातु क्षमेद्द्रौणिर्जानन्पौरुषमात्मनः।  उपचीर्णो गुरुर्मिथ्या भवता राज्यकारणात्॥३४॥
verses.english: The Panchala prince dragged my poor preceptor by the locks of his hair. Certainly Drona's son will not forgive that act of his, aware as he is of his own manliness and resources.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मज्ञेन सता नाम सोऽधर्मः सुमहान्कृतः।  चिरं स्थास्यति चाकीर्तिस्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे॥३५॥
verses.english: You also, O king, has spoken a lie to the preceptor, being driven to it by the desire for obtaining the kingdom. Conversant with the rules of morality and of pious nature, you have indeed perpetrated a great sin.

verses.sanskrit: रामे वालिवधाद्यद्वदेवं द्रोणे निपातिते।  सर्वधर्मोपपन्नोऽयं स मे शिष्यश्च पाण्डवः॥३६॥
verses.english: Like that hanging in Rama on consequence of his slaying Bali, the infamy hanging on you in consequence of the slaughter of Drona will be cternal in the three worlds with their mobile and immobile creations.

verses.sanskrit: नायं वदति मिथ्येति प्रत्ययं कृतवांस्त्वयि।  स सत्यकञ्चुकं नाम प्रविष्टेन ततोऽनृतम्॥३७॥
verses.english: “The son of Pandu is accomplished in all virtues; moreover he is my disciple, he will never tell me a lic.' Thinking this Drona believed what you then said.

verses.sanskrit: आचार्य उक्तो भवता हतः कुञ्जर इत्युत।  ततः शस्त्रं समुत्सृज्य निर्ममो गतचेतनः॥३८॥
verses.english: You have spoken an uniruth veiled in the garb of truth, to the preceptor, adding the word cicphant thereto.

verses.sanskrit: आसीत्सुविह्वलो राजन्यथा दृष्टस्त्वया विभुः।  स तु शोकसमाविष्टो विमुखः पुत्रवत्सलः॥३९॥
verses.english: Thereupon the Puissant Drona, laid his weapons aside and became indifferent to every carthly concern. He was senseless and as you have seen was overwhelmed with a swoon.

verses.sanskrit: शाश्वतं धर्ममुत्सृज्य गुरुः शस्त्रेण घातितः।  न्यस्तशस्त्रमधर्मेण घातयित्वा गुरुं भवान्॥४०॥
verses.english: It was then that his disciple, transgressing all morality, slew his preceptor, filled with do you you with affection for his son and unwilling to fight and possessed by grief.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षत्विदानीं सामात्यो यदि शक्तोऽसि पार्षतम्।  ग्रस्तमाचार्यपुत्रेण क्रुद्धेन हतबन्धुना॥४१॥
verses.english: Having slain by a deceitful means your preceptor who had laid his weapons aside, now your counsellors, protect the son of Prishata, if indeed, you arc equal to the task.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वयं परित्रातुं न शक्ष्यामोऽद्य पार्षतम्। सौहार्दं सर्वभूतेषु यः करोत्यतिमानुषः। सोऽद्य केशग्रहं श्रुत्वा पितुर्धक्ष्यति नो रणे॥४२॥
विक्रोशमाने हि मयि भृशमाचार्यगृद्धिनि। अपाकीर्य स्वयं धर्मं शिष्येण निहतो गुरुः॥४३॥
verses.english: Setting at naught all dictates of morality, the pupil has slaughtered his preceptor, although I exclaimed at the top of my voice, protesting that the preceptor should not be slain.

verses.sanskrit: यदा गतं वयो भूयः शिष्टमल्पतरं च नः। तस्येदानीं विकारोऽयमधर्मोऽयं कृतो महान्॥४४॥
verses.english: We have already passed away the greater part of our lives; the lease of life left to us is indeed very short; even that short period is blotted by his sinful act (perpetrated in the maturity of our years).

verses.sanskrit: पितेव नित्यं सौहार्दात्पितेवं हि च धर्मतः। सोल्पकालस्य राज्यस्य कारणाद्धातितो गुरुः॥४५॥
verses.english: Drona, in consequence of the affection he cherished for us, was indeed like our father. By the ordinances of the holy texts, he was also our father. Yet such a preceptor of ours has been slain by ourselves, for the sake of enjoying sovereignty for a short period.

verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्रेण भीष्माय द्रोणाय च विशांपते। विसृष्टा पृथिवी सर्वा सह पुत्रैश्च तत्परैः॥४६॥
संप्राप्य तादृशीं वृत्तिं सत्कृतः सततं परैः। अवृणीत सदा पुत्रान्मामेवाभ्यधिकं गुरुः॥४७॥
अवेक्षमाणस्त्वां मां च न्यस्तास्त्रश्चाहवे हतः। न त्वेनं युध्यमानं वै हन्यादपि शतक्रतुः॥४८॥
verses.english: The preceptor, incapable of suffering any reduction in strength and energy, was only slain in battle, when he believing in your words laid his weapons aside. While engaged in fight even Indra the performer of hundred sacrifices could not have defeated him.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याचार्यस्य वृद्धस्य द्रोहो नित्योपकारिणः। कृतो ह्यनार्यैरस्माभी राज्यार्थे लुब्धबुद्धिभिः॥४९॥
verses.english: Even such a preceptor, venerable in years and devoted to our welfare, has been injured by ourselves, who have betaken to mean conduct for securing sovereignty.

verses.sanskrit: अहो बत महत्पापं कृतं कर्म सुदारुणम्। यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन द्रोणोऽयं साधुघातितः॥५०॥
पुत्रान्भ्रातॄन्पिन्तॄदाराञ्जीवितं चैव वासविः। त्यजेत्सर्वं मम प्रेम्णा जानात्येवं हि मे गुरुः॥५१॥
verses.english: My preceptor had all along been under the impression, that I, Vasava's son, son, could abandon all, my sires, brothers, sons, wives and even life itself, for his sake, in consequence of the affection I bear for him.

verses.sanskrit: स मया राज्यकामेन हन्यमानो ह्युपेक्षितः। तस्माद‌र्वाक्शिराराजन्प्राप्तोस्मि नरकं प्रभो॥५२॥
ब्राह्मणं वृद्धमाचार्यं न्यस्तशस्त्रं महामुनिम्। घातयित्वाऽद्य राज्यार्थे मृतं श्रेयो न जीवितम्। ॥५३॥
